units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 11:20">Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 20</cite>.—
<cite ref="Gittin 70a:4">Gitt. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>האי מאן דבלע זי׳ וכ׳</he> he who swallowed a wasp cannot live.—
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:20">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite>, end <he>אמרין לז׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>אומרין</he>) people say to the wasp, we want neither thy sting nor thy honey.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:13">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>וקרירי לז׳</he> and cold water is good for the sting of a wasp.

<cite ref="Chagigah 5a:16">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> evils opposing each other <he>כגון ז׳ ועקרבא</he> as a bite of a wasp (requiring cold water) and one by a scorpion (requiring hot water); a. e.—Pl. <he>זִיבּוֹרֵי</he>. Targ. Y. Lev. l. c.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Megillah 14b:10">Meg. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>חדא שמה ז׳</he> one was named wasp (Deborah).—Pl. <he>זִיבּוֹרְיָיתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 118:12">Targ. Ps. CXVIII, 12</cite> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="G00267"><he>זִבּ׳</he></cite>).
